title: CAT 2024 Question Paper (Slot 1, QA) - Quant - Combinatorics
subject: Quant

questions.q: The sum of all four-digit numbers that can be formed with the distinct non-zero digits $a, b, c$, and ${d}$, with each digit appearing exactly once in every number, is $153310+n$, where ${n}$ is a single digit natural number. Then, the value of $(a+b+c+d+n)$ is
questions.explain: The sum of all numbers formed by ${n}$ distinct digits is $(n-1)! \times (\text{sum of digits}) \times (111...1 \text{ n times})$. Here, $n=4$. The sum is $(4-1)! \times (a+b+c+d) \times 1111 = 6 \times (a+b+c+d) \times 1111 = 6666(a+b+c+d)$. Let $S=a+b+c+d$. Then $6666S = 153310+n$. Dividing gives $S = (153310+n)/6666$. $153310/6666 \approx 23$. So we test $S=23$. $6666 \times 23 = 153318$. This means $153318=153310+n$, which gives $n=8$. The required value is $S+n = 23+8=31$.
